## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** Worker decides via `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`services/character.ts:159`): `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` (300/900/2700/6500/14000/23000/34000/48000/64000, max level 10) and `level < 10`. Returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` (`routes/action.ts:99`) and `POST /api/combat/resolve` (`routes/combat.ts:109`). UI shows a banner in the character sheet (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and an ability-choice picker in the console sidebar (`game-console.component.html:19-28`).

**Endpoint:** Picking an ability calls `levelUp(key)` (`game-console.component.ts:183`) → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` must be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha; 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**What changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- Level +1
- HP gain = roll of class hit die (Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6) + CON mod, added to both `max_hp` and current HP
- Chosen ability score +2 (no cap at 20)
- AC unchanged

Response also adds flavor text (`generateLevelUpNarrative`), a `[Level Up]` system log row, and a DM history turn (`routes/levelup.ts:39-50`). Frontend then updates character state, clears `canLevelUp`, shows a system message (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`). Only one level per call, even with enough XP for two.
